title: GradingQuestion
description: The information need a grading task is read against — a TREC-CDS-style topic for an `evidence-read`, the generated pointed question for a `pointed-read`, the user's query for `citation-feedback`. Shown to the reader labeled as the question, with `type` explained as *what the clinician has to decide*, never as a synthesis (docs/plans/grading-ui.md §3.4).

id.description: The study's identifier for the topic or query (e.g. the TREC CDS topic id `2016_1`). Informational; the task is keyed by `pair_id`.

type.description: The need type — what the reader is judging evidence *for* (TREC CDS: `diagnosis` | `treatment` | `test`; a pointed read records `pointed`). Free string so a new study does not need a contract change; the UI explains it, it never branches on it.

summary.description: One-line case summary (TREC CDS `summary`), or the pointed question itself.

description.description: The full case narrative (TREC CDS `description`). May equal `summary` when the question has no longer form.
